name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A rulebook and toolset that makes an AI coding agent plan and test its work properly before writing code, instead of guessing and producing messy code.
buyer: An engineering lead at a startup who has let developers loose with AI coding tools and is now cleaning up a codebase full of half-working, over-complicated AI-written code.
business_use_cases: A dev shop adopts it internally so every AI-assisted pull request follows the same spec-first, tested process instead of varying by whoever prompted it.
A solo freelancer uses it to make their AI-assisted delivery more consistent and defensible when a client asks 'how do I know this was tested?'.
A coding bootcamp teaches it as 'how to actually work with an AI pair programmer' rather than just vibes-based prompting.

money_ideas.idea: Paid training or workshops teaching teams the methodology.
Consulting engagements to set it up as the house standard at a dev shop.

steal_this: It's mostly a free methodology and toolkit for developers, not something you resell as-is — the real money is in teaching it, not packaging it.
